rule_migrations.source_path: package/专题页内容整理与初稿审阅流程.md
rule_migrations.handling: 移植业务规则；替换历史开发状态与样张导航
保留固定token/关系/容量/媒体；移除历史研究依赖及不随包演示导航，章节对应保留
根据独立C01–C12、媒体与容量关系有意识重写精简片段/CSS/JS，不携带演示正文、实验UI或完整资源表
根据审阅索引/批注/占位契约实现记录驱动展示，不复制示例业务正文
仅迁移静态资源分享能力（share/assets/unshare 与打包清洗）；剔除图片/视频/语音生成与任务轮询；share.js适配：默认BASE_URL为qingshui.hqwx.com、白名单hqwx.com/hqqt.com、.env读取skill根目录；1.9.1在来源逻辑上追加青藤放大图静态降级、位图预检与本地回归

historical_research_boundary: The locked foundation previously recorded html-content-layout as concluded structural research only. This Skill does not read/call/write/sync it and has no runtime dependency.

upgrade_baseline.reason: real-test editorial, composition, capacity, review and acceptance upgrade

editorial_upgrade.scope: reader-facing copy/evidence selection, editorial examples, hierarchy, revision review and media context; official header/routes unchanged, footer/dialog copy made reader-facing

visual_upgrade.scope: Original light/tone surface recipes and content symbols; editorial/revision examples, visible clipping, version-bound reports, scoped CSS and recoverable task snapshots, native mobile footer groups
visual_upgrade.reference_boundary: User screenshot used locally as visual language only; no screenshot, people, business text or third-party logos shipped

typography_revision.reason: User rejected flat/small whole-page text hierarchy; role scale replaces tag-only sizes

production_repair.scope: Visible frame/field alignment and content-aware cluster reflow; explicit image decisions; execution permission separate from review; open user findings invalidate acceptance
production_repair.boundary: No fixed card heights or required image counts; no business content or live generation in the runtime

editorial_expression_revision.scope: semantic task focus, local display typography and emphasis, artifact symbols, visual stages, value tiles, tonal evidence and visual review
editorial_expression_revision.boundary: No business page, user screenshot, private text or new font dependency shipped; no original feedback automatically resolved

reading_revision.scope: Early title/anchor checks, media reading focus, complete/preview coverage, byte cache and export; shared blocks unchanged

outcome_revision.scope: Case information retention, semantic image review, explicit inner/baseline alignment, continuous steps, preserved evidence reading point and purpose-scoped delivery conclusions
outcome_revision.boundary: No user consent or factual judgment generated by checks; installed skill and existing business output unchanged

alignment_revision.scope: Natural media independent from peer frames; custom composition discovery; sparse evidence reflow; content-tail and painted photo-column checks; reader-value copy decisions
alignment_revision.boundary: No private screenshots or business artifact shipped; tests do not grant visual quality or user acceptance

requirements_revision.scope: Pinned independent asset requirements, task snapshots, actual embedded media and separate fulfillment/visual review
requirements_revision.boundary: Recorded requirements and provider evidence are not proof of user authenticity or generation quality

remote_merge.scope: Optional share scripts and public-shell null guards merged with local1.8; no business page shared

share_safety_revision.scope: Preserve topic images when the share sanitizer removes zoom buttons; add no-upload size and raster-pixel preflight plus Node regression coverage
share_safety_revision.boundary: Pixel count is a heuristic for server-side PNG transcoding risk and does not claim an upload will succeed

page_mode_revision.scope: Structured report/course/catalog/operations/campaign routing, user-selected mode evidence, at-most-two list-approved direction previews and deterministic catalog validation
page_mode_revision.boundary: Mode recommendations do not approve a content list, create facts or assets, prove semantic correctness, or publish a preview

navigation_revision.scope: In-flow real-anchor contents and Day/stage indexes with active-location enhancement, horizontal mobile browsing and no hidden sections
navigation_revision.boundary: Navigation does not infer chapter structure, completion state or user progress; all authored targets still require review

input_adapter_revision.scope: Structured text/Feishu/DOCX/PDF/spreadsheet/web/image/video/mixed input inventory, honest extraction states and SHA-bound source snapshots
input_adapter_revision.boundary: The catalog and validator do not parse, fetch, authenticate, verify source claims or infer unread content

document_viewer_revision.scope: Explicit content-redesign/source-viewer/hybrid strategy, source-page records and an all-pages-in-DOM progressive original-document viewer
document_viewer_revision.boundary: The viewer does not render PDF/DOCX files, invent unavailable pages, verify source claims or approve a content list

delivery_quality_revision.scope: Current-composer artifact identity, exact installed-version diagnosis, final single-file runtime-resource rejection and completion-required CLI gate
delivery_quality_revision.boundary: The identity proves which local runtime composed and checked the artifact; it does not by itself prove editorial quality, factual truth or user acceptance
